protocol.optimizer: AdamW lr=.001 weight_decay=.0001 clip_norm=1;uniform regime/fit day/context start
protocol.matching: All original TCN/attention parameters identical before training per seed;identical patch sequence and center supervision
protocol.GRU: Two layers,bidirectional hidden24x2,residual gain init.1;additional parameters,not a capacity-matched causal proof
protocol.sampling_policy: Uniform supervised center time;clip core then context at day boundaries;all day cells have positive sampling probability
protocol.checkpoint: Max pure neural cal State every4epochs,first wins ties
protocol.selection: Per-seed architecture blend cal only;fixed equal-seed means;primary max cal over all plus incumbent/full-LGB
protocol.diagnostics: Observed5min speed drop/recover>=20kmh;missing-speed input run>=12/36steps;observed speed<50
protocol.truth_scope: Public train raw labels evaluator/loss only;fixed-context predictor accepts no labels/masks
protocol.assessment_status: Previously viewed public-train development calendars;not new final/private evidence

limitations: Two optimizer seeds share existing fit/cal/assessment dates and fixed full-LGB. All are previously viewed public-train development. GRU adds capacity;not exact parameter-budget isolation. Fixed finite context changes inference versus incumbent full-day. Observed transitions are noisy measurement diagnostics,not latent event truth. Increment score is incomplete physical proxy only.
